page.overview:
Who is Broon?

Broon was a human male scrumrat of the White Worms gang on the Core Worlds planet Corellia. Around 13 BBY, they and the fellow human scrumrat Fixit helped prepare for a raid on a Corellia shipyard by monitoring the facility in shifts, often taking turns with the Rodian scrumrat Oggro.

In one instance, when Imperial stormtroopers exited a hangar and began scanning the area around the shipyard, Broon and their companion fled back to the den of the White Worms to tell someone, not waiting for Oggro to replace them at their posting. The pair told the older scrumrat Qi'ra of the situation, with Broon indicating they had not yet told the Rodian what they had learned. After promising to pass on the information, she dismissed the boys for dinner.

The human male Broon lived on planet Corellia during the Imperial Era. They eventually joined the White Worms criminal gang as a scrumrat thief and lived within their Coronet City den under Head scrumrat Ema's management, alongside several other orphans. the White Worms prepared to raid a Corellia shipyard to steal control boards under the orders of their leader, Lady Proxima, who hoped the endeavor would result in the deaths of several of her older scrumrats so she could thin her ranks.

As one of the group's younger scrumrats, Broon paired off with the fellow human scrumrat Fixit to monitor the shipyard as a scout. The boys took shifts at a watching post during the day, while the Rodian scrumrat Oggro would come to relieve the boys and take the night shift. One time, while waiting for the Rodian to take their place, they and their partner were surprised to see a large group of Imperial stormtroopers scanning the nearby area as they marched out of the facility's hangar. Broon and Fixit fled their post and returned to the White Worms' den to inform someone of the information, not waiting for Oggro to replace them.
